title: Add classify_subject_or_landscape function
goal:
Add a new function immediately after is_blurry, implemented exactly as follows:

def classify_subject_or_landscape(image_path):
    """Classifies an image as 'subject', 'landscape', or 'unclear' using CLIP embeddings."""
    try:
        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        image_embedding = model.encode(image)
        label_keys = list(CLASSIFICATION_LABELS.keys())
        label_embeddings = model.encode([CLASSIFICATION_LABELS[k] for k in label_keys])
        scores = util.cos_sim(image_embedding, label_embeddings)[0]
        best_idx = int(scores.argmax())
        best_score = float(scores[best_idx])
        if best_score < CLASSIFICATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
            return "unclear"
        return label_keys[best_idx]
    except Exception:
        return "unclear"
acceptance_criteria: classify_subject_or_landscape(image_path) is defined and returns one of the strings 'subject', 'landscape', or 'unclear'
It uses the existing global model (SentenceTransformer) and util.cos_sim rather than loading a new model
It returns 'unclear' instead of raising on an unreadable/corrupt image (wrapped in try/except)
The best-scoring label is only accepted if its score is >= CLASSIFICATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
